en.title: Report chunk progress for packaged World3D models on Android
en.body: Games can observe packaged GLB bytes and cancel a load between chunks. A textured terrain example covers retrying the same file and releasing its geometry and texture page on the Fold7.

zh.title: Android 包内三维模型支持分块进度通知
zh.body: 游戏可观察 GLB 的实际读取进度，并在块间取消导入。带贴图的地形示例在 Fold7 上验证了重试同一文件，以及几何与贴图页的回收。
